<p>Returns true if <span class="doxyComputerOutput">C</span> is a valid character in an identifier.</p>


<p>If <span class="doxyComputerOutput">First</span> is true, returns true if <span class="doxyComputerOutput">C</span> is a valid first character of an identifier, else returns true if <span class="doxyComputerOutput">C</span> is a valid non-first character of an identifier. Identifiers match the following regular expression: [a-zA-Z_][0-9a-zA-Z_]*</p>
